title: Unit 12 Consolidation: liberalism and modernization
goal: Review liberal ideas, the Mexican Reforma, Church and State, railways and immigrants, and the export model.

items: Talk about liberalism with *a medida que* and *cuanto más… más*, the passive with *ser*, impersonal *se*, the gerund and ordering markers.
Say what liberals wanted and who could not vote.
Say what the Reforma changed in Mexico and how Church and State were treated.
Say how railways, ports and immigrants changed society.
Use the words of the unit: liberal, vote, reform, railway and positivism.
